_doc: Per-slug EU SmPC (EMA) choices for tools/drugdb/fetch_eu_smpc.py, kept so the weekly run does not drift back.
prefer: EMA medicine names tried first, in order (case-insensitive exact name); the normal ranking applies within and after them.
exclude: EMA medicine names never used for this slug. If nothing is left, the generic gets no EU SmPC.
valency: for vaccines, keep only EMA products with this valency (e.g. 10 for a 10-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine).
none: true = never show an EU SmPC for this slug (the matching EMA product is a different medicine).
A valency stated in the generic's own name or registered names is applied automatically; set it here to pin it or to supply it.

ibandronic-acid.reason: PH ibandronic acid is used for osteoporosis; prefer Bonviva (osteoporosis) over Bondronat (oncology).

glycopyrronium-indacaterol.reason: Same product information; prefer Ultibro Breezhaler over the duplicate Xoterna Breezhaler.

pneumococcal-polysaccharide-conjugate-va.reason: PH registrations are 10-valent (Synflorix BR-685/BR-800/BR-1310; Pneumosil BR-1350/BR-1351). Synflorix is the 10-valent EMA product.

pneumococcal-conjugate-vaccine-13-valent.reason: PH product is Prevenar 13 (BR-1133, BR-1308); match the 13-valent EMA product.

pneumococcal-polysaccharide-conjugate-va.reason: PH product is Pneumocon-13 (Yuxi Walvax; tetanus-toxoid carrier protein, BR-1451/BR-1452). The only 13-valent EMA product, Prevenar 13, is a different vaccine (CRM197 carrier), so its SmPC is not shown. Flagged for Dr. Rivero; to show Prevenar 13 instead, replace this entry with {"valency": 13, "prefer": ["Prevenar 13"]}.
PH product is Vaxneuvance (BR-1425); match the 15-valent EMA product.

amino-acids.reason: PH 'amino acids' products are parenteral nutrition solutions; Maapliv is a specific metabolic-disorder product and must not be used.
